QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_35

question.text: Which body is the notified Self-Regulatory Organisation (SRO) for Social Impact Assessors in India?

answer.text: ICMAI — Institute of Cost Accountants of India
Institute of Social Auditors of India (ISAI) — a Section 8 company under the aegis of ICAI
ICSI — Institute of Company Secretaries of India
SEBI — Securities and Exchange Board of India

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes the SRO as the Institute of Social Auditors of India (ISAI), a Section 8 company set up under the aegis of ICAI. SIAs register with an SRO under ICAI or another SEBI-specified agency. The Trap: ICMAI (cost accountants) and ICSI (company secretaries) are separate professional bodies, not the SIA SRO. SEBI is the capital-market regulator, not the SRO for SIAs. Note: The SRO is set up under the aegis of ICAI, but the SRO itself is the Section 8 company (ISAI), not ICAI directly.
